caseName: New Orleans Land Co. v. Roussel
caseNameFull: New Orleans Land Company v. Willis J. Roussel, Administrator, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Louisiana.
attorneys: Mr. Charles Louque, with whom Mr. W. O. Hart was on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Mr. William Winans Wall, for defendants in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of §237 of.the Judicial Cede, as amended by the Act of *572September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726.
